extensions.name: Audiobook Catalog
extensions.description: Trending and most read books, new releases and genres for the home screen, with narrators, length and ratings.

extensions.name: Audiobook Scraper
extensions.description: Finds audiobooks on public indexers and plays them through your debrid service.

extensions.name: Audiobook Torrents
extensions.description: Finds audiobooks on public indexers and plays the torrents in the app, with no account. Your IP address is visible to everyone sharing the book; a VPN is strongly advised.

extensions.name: Golden Audiobooks
extensions.description: Plays audiobooks from Golden Audiobooks, which streams them as MP3 files: no torrents and no account. Mostly popular English books.
